player_prompt.intro:
Ko a yi {role} caggal Colonel Blotto.
Ko a guuri ko a yiɗa kadi wonde aɓe.
Caggal kala, wali kadi {num_total_units} ɓeyngu caggal leydi {field_names}.
Ko o wali ɓeyngu ɗuuɗɗo leydi o heɓi leydi ɗen, e ko o heɓi leyɗe ɗuuɗɗe o heɓi kadi ɗen.
Ala misaal, '[A7 B7 C6]' wali 7 ɓeyngu caggal A, 7 caggal B, e 6 caggal C.
player_prompt.commander_alpha: Komando Alfa, ɓe ɗon ɗaɓɓita on.
